## Save as recipe… on the saved Style A (from_style_id)
  1  GET /api/core-nodes
  2  POST /api/processes/1/presets
       {
         "name": "From A",
         "from_style_id": 1
       }
  3  GET /api/processes/1/presets
-- sheet closed

## + New recipe, then + Add a position: two_robot_press_index on POS_A11
  1  GET /api/processes/1/composer
-- sheet closed
-- bar ok

## Save recipe… on that draft (cells, no groups)
  1  GET /api/core-nodes
  2  POST /api/processes/1/presets
       {
         "name": "Fresh",
         "cells": [
           {
             "core_node_name": "POS_A11",
             "role": "consume",
             "swap_mode": "two_robot_press_index",
             "payload_code": "",
             "paired_core_node": "POS_B1",
             "inbound_source": "GRP_A",
             "outbound_destination": "DST_1"
           }
         ]
       }
  3  GET /api/processes/1/composer
  4  POST /api/processes/1/flow/preview
       (the boot preview's body, as requests-open-process.txt pins it)
-- sheet closed

## Recipe One opened from the rail, then Set up groups
-- sheet closed
-- groups ["2‑Robot Index of POS_A1","2‑Robot Swap of POS_A3"]

## Save recipe… with groups (saveGroupedRecipe), the name as it opens
  1  GET /api/core-nodes
  2  POST /api/processes/1/presets
       {
         "name": "Recipe One",
         "cells": [
           {
             "core_node_name": "POS_A1",
             "role": "consume",
             "swap_mode": "two_robot_press_index",
             "payload_code": "",
             "paired_core_node": "POS_B1",
             "inbound_source": "GRP_A",
             "outbound_destination": "DST_1"
           },
           {
             "core_node_name": "POS_A3",
             "role": "consume",
             "swap_mode": "two_robot",
             "payload_code": "",
             "inbound_source": "GRP_A",
             "inbound_staging": "STG_1",
             "outbound_destination": "DST_1"
           }
         ],
         "groups": [
           {
             "of": "POS_A1",
             "name": "2‑Robot Index",
             "spots": [
               {
                 "core_node_name": "POS_A1",
                 "paired_core_node": [
                   "POS_B1"
                 ]
               }
             ]
           },
           {
             "of": "POS_A3",
             "name": "2‑Robot Swap",
             "spots": [
               {
                 "core_node_name": "POS_A3",
                 "inbound_staging": [
                   "STG_1"
                 ]
               }
             ]
           }
         ]
       }
  3  GET /api/processes/1/composer
  4  GET /api/processes/1/composer
  5  POST /api/processes/1/flow/preview
       (the boot preview's body, as requests-open-process.txt pins it)
-- sheet closed
